reviews.x: This product simply does not do what it advertises. It will not sterilize. No UV light is emitted.  As an optometrist, I have instruments to evaluate what type of light is emitted from the machine. There is little or no UV light coming from the bulb. This feels quite a lot like a scam. As UV light is not visible to the human eye, this can be hard for the average person to verify, so I send my warning.

reviews.t: Practical sanitizing without heat or water, reassuring.
reviews.x: Large enough to hold face masks, debit cards, key fobs, currency etc. Unit shuts off if door is opened mid-cycle. Great way to disinfect items without heat or water. Leaves a very faint “fresh” smell from minimal ozone production - pleasant and reassuring. By the way, I verified strong UVC production by this unit using an American Ultraviolet UVC Dosimeter card, commonly used to prove UVC disinfection in healthcare settings. Definitely recommend this unit to others!

This sterilizer is the best product in the market, especially on Amazon. It will be much more convenient when you know how to use it. I like this perfect size and functions, good for any type of sterilization.
This product does emit UVC in the correct range to sanitize for COVID. In the picture you can see a fresh test card on the left and one after exposure on the right.

claims.text: Many reviewers report the unit works well for sanitizing masks, phones, keys, and other small items.
A recurring complaint is that units arrive defective or stop working, sometimes after only a few uses.
Several reviewers mention ozone production, with some finding the smell faint and reassuring and others finding it pungent or a safety concern.
Some reviewers question whether the device actually emits UV light or effectively sterilizes as advertised.
A few reviewers report poor construction and customer service issues, including missing units, loose screws, and return shipping costs.
